Name: gilded garden
Author: flowersinrevolt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds many decor items to your game (40+ items). Includes rose clutter, swags, a mausoleum, broken toys, and wall art. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires: SMAPI, Calcifer, Content Patcher, Precise Furniture,  and Happy Home Designer to function correctly.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Purchase the catalogue at Pierre's. Every item except the wall art supports being placed inside and outside. Item placement is intentionally kept at 1x1 so you can build up dramatic landscapes. This mod really sets a melancholy tone/mood. This is part of a much larger project, so there will be updates. 

Includes 3 seasonal items: rose bush, rose stall, and the dollhouse catalogue.
